scope.activation: explicit opt-in only; never enabled by default and never applied to historical results

orderOfOperations: strip one triple-backtick code fence only when it wraps the whole answer
strip one matching whole-string quote/backtick pair only when the inner text contains no same-kind quote character; otherwise leave the string unchanged
for set/ordered: parse a valid JSON array if present; otherwise strip one outer [] layer when present; otherwise split on comma, semicolon, Chinese comma, Chinese semicolon or newline
for each list element: trim and strip one matching element quote/backtick pair only when the inner text contains no same-kind quote character
drop empty list elements; preserve order and duplicates for ordered; join list elements with ', '
pass the normalized value to the unchanged gradeAnswer
allowedTransformations: whitespace trim and whitespace-run collapse already performed by exactText
one layer of paired quote/backtick wrapper around a whole answer
one layer of paired quote/backtick wrapper per list element
list delimiter split and canonical comma-space join

testVectors.manifestDisclosure: Only aggregate count, hash and category metadata is public; actual test-vector inputs and expected values remain private in the N2 proposal.
testVectors.hashBasis: sha256 of canonical JSON (object keys sorted) of the private 21-vector set

offlineReplay.method: Read the existing 20 raw JSON files and re-grade locally with the proposed v2 normalizer; no reader, no network, no raw-file writes.
offlineReplay.summarizeStatusWarning: v2 would make summarize.status PASS because degraded becomes empty; this is NOT the K-2 gate. gate6 remains false because unknownIncrease is still 1.

nonGoals: do not modify existing normalizeAnswer or gradeAnswer
do not change questions, answers, aliases, graders or thresholds
do not re-run any real reader model
do not rewrite the 2026-11-08 T7 raw results or k2-result.json
